topic: How does antenna design influence the accuracy of encrypted traffic classification systems in heterogeneous satellite networks?
consensus_response: Antenna complexity directly impacts classification accuracy by introducing increased crosstalk and polarization correlation, which negatively affects classifier performance. High-density antennas exacerbate this issue due to their large element count, leading to signal distortion and reduced SNR. This necessitates careful antenna design to minimize polarization correlation and maximize signal integrity for optimal classification accuracy in complex satellite communication environments.
reference_context: The complexity of antenna designs significantly impacts classification accuracy. High-density antennas introduce increased crosstalk and polarization correlation, impacting classifier performance. These interferences can mask signal characteristics and hinder classifier accuracy.  A robust classifier should utilize adaptive modulation schemes and advanced signal processing techniques to mitigate these effects and maintain accurate classification under complex interference scenarios.
